payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputed 2D arrays (vertical/horizontal same-color runs) via DP recurrence; then enumerated all cells as bottom-right corners, checking stripe height conditions to count valid flags.
payload.rationale: The solution builds tables cols and rows using DP transitions (if same color, extend previous run). These 2D state arrays are then used in a counting loop, which is typical of DP precomputation for enumeration. No other family fits better.
